why: Take 3 has the most life: money arriving first makes a much-burned driver suspicious, and that drives the demand for exact terms. I applied the review's fixes except its cut of the send-off. Route B has the turned driver warn the rivals' lookout off [dd8b9b4144cb97176295edbd, 824dc977c7edf50d72a1db3e], and the scene sheet requires the offer. For Aster: the review treats this send-off as the Scout's false tip, and that needs correcting or a ruling from Sky.
changes: Line 1: dropped the figure as the review asked, because the scene sheet gives no price. The review's reason is off: §07 prices the driver at Pay $70,000 or Help $40,000 [dd8b9b4144cb97176295edbd, 824dc977c7edf50d72a1db3e], while the purse and people rules use $40,000 [cd8c0574c7d27811e99467f1, ab8f73121466f6e810b67979], apparently the Help price. Aster should confirm.

Line 8: now "The back seat's our business", as the review asked. It says nothing about how the Take goes, so it holds for both the built and the decided versions [12f568e600e22c6cfd665124]. The review's reason is only partly right: the human GDD still has the Enforcer taking Vale from the back seat [dd8b9b4144cb97176295edbd].

Line 9: dropped "free", since nothing sets that price, but did not make the requested cut to "I don't see that." The send-off is the driver warning the rivals' lookout off, which is in route B and separate from the Scout's false tip, the part in question [dd8b9b4144cb97176295edbd]. Cutting it would also drop a line the sheet requires.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Paid, and I haven't heard the job. Nobody pays first.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We do. We hear the Councillor's driver has had a lean month.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: I don't ask who "we" is. Last time, the money stopped.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Then you're the only honest person on Apron Road, Zhou.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Honest is extra. I've been paid for "small favours", so what, exactly?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: At the chime, take the Councillor to the service bay. Not home.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: East yard. A couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Long enough. The back seat's our business.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: I don't see that. Anyone watching my bay, I'll send off.

learned: Paid: Vale's car waits out back.
